violations.message: RiskReport must link at least one evidence id.

input_narrative: SYNTHETIC NARRATIVE: Synthetic field service engineering desk reported that the device failed to flag a clinically significant atrial fibrillation episode in real time. A retrospective clinician review confirms a single missed, sustained atrial fibrillation episode that self-resolved with no recorded adverse outcome; no second occurrence has yet been confirmed. The only artifact attached references a prior unrelated release's static-analysis output, not this incident.

The device's performance deviated from its intended use, requiring investigation under EU MDR Annex I, Section 17.1 regarding electronic programmable systems which mandates repeatability, reliability, and performance in line with intended use. Furthermore, this incident triggers obligations related to the software development lifecycle as outlined in EU MDR Annex I, Section 17.2, emphasizing risk management and verification/validation.
